name: Agent700 AI Chat
author: LevelUp Development

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress site with Agent 700 AI, an advanced chatbot specialized in providing intelligent assistance for your products. With this plugin, you can:

  • Offer real-time support to your customers.
  • Provide detailed answers about your products.
  • Reduce response time and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Seamlessly integrate AI-powered conversations into your site.

The plugin settings can be found in the WordPress admin dashboard under Settings > Agent700 Chat.

Features:

  • Easy setup and configuration.
  • Responsive design compatible with mobile and desktop devices.
  • AI-driven responses tailored to your products.
  • Automatically displays a chat icon for easy user access.
  • Option to disable the chat icon via plugin settings.
  • Supports shortcode [agent700_chat] to display the chat manually.
  • Customizable chat interface to match your brand.
  • Ability to change the chat icon image
  • Aside or Popup chat layout selection
  • Added option to hide or show chat overlay
  • Expanded popup layout (only with popup layout)

This plugin is perfect for e-commerce, product-based websites, or any business looking to provide fast, reliable support to their users.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the Agent 700 AI Chat?

The setup is simple! After installing and activating the plugin, go to the plugin settings in the WordPress admin dashboard, configure your API key, and customize the chat widget as needed.

Is the plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with most WordPress themes. If you encounter any layout issues, you can adjust the CSS in the plugin settings.

Where can I find the plugin settings?

The plugin settings are located in the WordPress admin dashboard under Settings > Agent700 Chat.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

Not at all! The plugin is user-friendly and requires no coding. All settings can be managed directly from the admin interface.

Can I customize the chat interface?

Yes, the plugin offers options to adjust the chat’s appearance to match your site’s branding, including colors, fonts, and positioning.

What happens when I activate the plugin?

When activated, the plugin automatically displays a chat icon on your site, allowing users to open the AI-powered chat.

Can I disable the chat icon?

Yes, you can disable the chat icon in the plugin settings under Admin > Settings > Agent700 Chat > Hide chat icon.

How can I manually add the chat to a specific location?

You can use the following shortcode to display the chat widget manually:

[agent700_chat]
